facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that CAR's national fibre backbone was commissioned in 2023 under the Central African Backbone project, with about 935 km deployed, including the Bangui-Boali and Carnot-Berberati routes, and serves as a national backbone.

Ecofin Agency reports that CAR's roughly 935 km fibre links it with the Republic of Congo and Cameroon as its gateway to international connectivity, with Camtel providing international connectivity and the ministry reporting damage on 13 March 2026.

CAF.note: The document says nothing about local government offices.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that CAR's backbone, commissioned in 2023 under the Central African Backbone project meant to connect ECCAS countries, links CAR with the Republic of Congo and Cameroon, with Camtel providing international connectivity.
